blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent progress in generative models has made talking-head deepfakes highly realistic and easy to create, jeopardizing public trust. However, most audio-visual deepfake detectors rely on lip-speech synchronization and are designed for static, frontal videos, limiting their reliability in dynamic, in-the-wild recordings where the speaker moves and lip cues are degraded or missing. As an alternative, we propose a physics-aware detector for dynamic speaking videos that leverages an acoustic constraint: in real recordings, speech energy varies predictably with speaker-to-camera distance, whereas deepfake generation can break this coupling. Our method combines distance estimates from video with distance-dependent acoustic measures from speech to detect deepfakes. Experiments on in-the-wild benchmarks show that the proposed physical cue is effective in dynamic scenarios, and that it complements lip-sync-based detectors, with a simple ensemble achieving consistent gains across datasets. Codes are available at https://byulharang.github.io/PADD/.
blocks.zh: 最近在基因模型方面取得的进展,使说话头的深层假象非常现实而容易被创造,损害了公众的信任. 然而,大多数的视听深假探测器都依赖于唇音同步,并被设计为静态,前相的视频,限制了其在动态,内相的录音中的可靠性,其中扬声器移动和唇音提示被退化或缺失. 作为另一种选择,我们提出一个物理感知探测器,用于利用声学限制的动态语音视频:在真实的录音中,语音能量随着扬声器对相机的相距而发生可预计的变化,而深假相机一代可以打破这种耦合. 我们的方法结合了视频的距离估计和从语音到检测深层假象的距离依赖声学测量. 有关 " 万能 " 基准的实验表明,拟议的物理提示在动态情景中是有效的,它补充了以唇合成为基础的探测器,有一个简单的组合,实现各数据集的一致收益。 编码见https://byulharang.github.io/PADD/。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent advances in deep generative models [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] have dramatically increased the realism and accessibility of synthetic media, raising the risk of convincing deepfake videos in everyday communication channels and public discourse [ 4 , 5 ] .
To defense these threats, various detection methods have been developed for video forensics, ranging from detection of visual artifacts [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] to verification of temporal and spatial consistency [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] .
In particular, manipulating a human speech video is especially threatening
since it can distort identity (visual appearance) and intent (speech content), and may influence perceived beliefs and decisions even with a short clip, exacerbating misinformation and jeopardizing public trust.
This highlights the need for robust audio-visual deepfake detection.
blocks.zh:
近期在深层基因模型[1,2,3]方面的进步,极大地提高了合成媒体的现实主义和可获取性,增加了在日常交流渠道和公共言论中说服深层假视频的风险[4,5].
为了防范这些威胁,为视频法证开发了各种探测方法,从探测视觉文物[6、7、8]到核查时间和空间一致性[9、10、11]。
特别是操纵人语录影带 尤其具有威胁性
因为它可能扭曲身份(视觉外观)和意图(言论内容),甚至可能用短片片片影响人们的信仰和决定,加剧错误信息,危害公众信任。
这突出表明,必须进行强有力的视听深层假探测。

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : Physics-aware deepfake detection for dynamic speaking videos. Existing detectors rely on lip–speech consistency and may fail when lip regions are partially visible or missing.
Our method instead exploits the physical relationship between speaker distance and speech energy, enabling reliable detection even when visual lip cues are unreliable.
blocks.zh:
图1:动态语音视频的物理意识深假检测. 现有的探测器依赖于唇语的一致性,在唇片区域部分可见或缺失时可能失效.
相反,我们的方法利用了语音距离和语音能量之间的物理关系,使得即使在视觉嘴唇提示不可靠时也能进行可靠的检测。

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : Physics-aware deepfake detection framework. Our method extracts speaker distance and acoustic measures from video and audio streams.
For speaker distance, we calculated d s ​ p ​ k d_{spk} by averaging monocular depth values (MiDaS [ 12 ] ) within facial landmarks (RetinaFace [ 13 ] ). For acoustic measures, SNR and C 50 C_{50} were calculated using speech and noise separated by SAM-Audio [ 14 ] with a ’speech’ prompt.
Distance-wise binning is then applied and the variance and entropy of the acoustic measures are aggregated to form statistical features 𝐯 \mathbf{v} .
Finally, 𝐯 \mathbf{v} is fed into a lightweight MLP detector to predict whether it is an authentic or a deepfake video.
blocks.zh:
图2 物理学认识深假检测框架. 我们的方法从视频和音频流中提取了扬声器距离和声学测量。
对于扬声器的距离,我们通过面部地标(RetinaFace [13])内平均单元深度值(MiDAS [12])来计算d s p k d_{spk}。 在声学测量方面,SNR和C 50 C_{50}是用SAM-Audio[14]在Speech的提示下分开的语音和噪音计算出来的。
然后应用远程双键,并汇总声学测量的差值和 en,形成统计特征 v\mathbf{v}.
最后,v\mathbf{v}被输入一个轻量级的MLP探测器,以预测它是真实的还是深假的视频.

blocks.en:
Most existing audio-visual deepfake detection methods have primarily exploited the strong correlation between speech and lip motion, analyzing lip-speech synchronization to detect subtle mismatches [ 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 ] .
These approaches have shown to be effective in videos where the speaker’s mouth is clearly visible and unobstructed, such as news, interviews, podcasts, and studio-like recordings [ 20 , 21 , 8 , 22 ] .
However, this reliance on lip–speech synchronization limits practical deployment to relatively constrained settings, such as static talking head videos with frontal faces, stable lighting, and limited camera motion, where the lip region remains consistently visible.
blocks.zh:
大多数现有的视听深假检测方法主要利用了语音和唇动之间的强烈关联,分析唇音同步以检测微妙的不匹配[15,16,17,18,19].
这些方法在发言者的口语清晰可见且不受阻碍的视频中,如新闻、采访、播客和录音室式录音[20、21、8、22]中证明是有效的。
然而,这种对唇语同步的依赖将实际部署限制在相对受限的环境下,比如有正面面部的静态说话头部视频,稳定的照明,以及有限的相机运动,唇语区域始终可见.

blocks.en:
As generative tools rapidly advance while becoming cheaper and easier to use, deepfakes are no longer limited to carefully curated static talking head clips; instead, they increasingly appear in dynamic, in-the-wild videos where a subject moves through space while speaking, such as handheld recordings, vlogs, or on-the-street interviews.
While effective under controlled and static conditions, the aforementioned approaches become unreliable in dynamic speaking videos, where the speaker naturally moves toward or away from the camera and facial cues are often degraded by occlusion, pose changes, and motion blur.
blocks.zh:
随着基因工具的迅速发展,同时变得更加便宜和容易使用,深层假象不再局限于精心整理的静态说话头片段;相反,它们越来越出现在动态的,浑浊的视频中,一个主题在说话时通过空间移动,如手持录音,vlogs,或者街上采访.
虽然在控制和静态条件下有效,但上述方法在动态的演讲视频中变得不可靠,在视频中,演讲者自然地向着镜头移动或远离镜头,面部提示往往被遮蔽,产生变化,运动模糊.

blocks.en:
To address this gap, we propose a physics-aware deepfake detection framework for dynamic human speaking videos. Our key motivation is that authentic recordings must satisfy basic acoustic constraints: speech intensity varies predictably with the speaker-to-camera distance, approximately following an inverse relationship [ 23 ] .
Although current deepfake generation and compositing methods can produce highly realistic content, they often neglect this physical relationship and may break the coupling between visual geometry and speech energy.
Our approach estimates the speaker’s relative distance from the visual stream and compares it against speech-energy patterns expected from sound propagation. This provides a complementary detection signal that remains informative even when lip details are unreliable, and targets violations of the physical relationship between what is seen (distance/motion) and what is heard (speech intensity) in dynamic deepfake videos (refer to Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这一差距,我们提议为动态的人类演讲视频建立一个物理学意识的深假检测框架。 我们的关键动机是,作准录音必须满足基本的声学限制: 语音强度随着演讲者对相机的距离而变化, 大约在逆向关系之后[23].
虽然目前的深假生成和堆肥方法可以产生高度现实化的内容,但它们往往忽视这种物理关系,并可能打破视觉几何和语音能量的结合.
我们估计演讲者与视觉流的相对距离, 这提供了一种补充的检测信号,即使在嘴唇细节不可靠时,这种信号仍然具有信息性,并针对在动态的深假视频(参考图1)中所看到的(距离/运动)和所听到的(话语强度)之间的物理关系的侵犯.

blocks.en:
We validate the effectiveness of our approach on multiple audio-visual deepfake detection benchmarks that include dynamic videos [ 19 , 24 ] . When we explicitly extract dynamic subsets from these benchmarks and evaluate on those videos, our physics-aware model outperforms prior detectors that primarily focus on lip–speech alignment [ 18 , 19 ] . Moreover, our method performs favorably as a standalone detector compared to existing approaches. Because our physical-consistency cue complements prior detectors, ensembling it with existing models achieves substantial additional gains.
To our knowledge, this is the first work to use audio-visual physical constraints as a primary cue for deepfake video detection. Our main contributions are: • Introduce a distance–speech consistency measure that reflects basic acoustic behavior in real dynamic speaking videos. • Propose an audio-visual deepfake detector that leverages this measure as a primary cue for detection in dynamic settings. • Demonstrate robust performance on dynamic speaking videos and consistent ensemble gains with lip–speech synchronization detectors, indicating complementarity.
blocks.zh:
我们验证我们在包括动态视频在内的多种视听深假探测基准方面的做法的有效性[19、24]。 当我们明确地从这些基准中提取动态子集并对这些视频进行评估时,我们的物理认知模型就超越了主要侧重于唇语对齐的先导探测器[18,19]. 此外,与现有方法相比,我们的方法作为独立的探测器表现良好。 因为我们的物理一致性提示 补充了前置探测器, 使它与现有的模型相融合 实现了巨大的额外收益。
据我们所知,这是首次利用视听物理限制作为深假视频探测的主要线索。 我们的主要贡献是 : 引入一个距离 - 语音一致性度量, · 提出一个视听深假探测器,利用这一措施作为在动态环境中进行探测的主要提示。 · 显示动态语音视频的强效性能,并用唇音同步探测器取得一致的共聚效应,表明互补性。

blocks.en: Introduce a distance–speech consistency measure that reflects basic acoustic behavior in real dynamic speaking videos.
blocks.zh: 在真实的动态语音视频中引入一个反映基本声学行为的距离 - 语音一致性测量 。

blocks.en: Propose an audio-visual deepfake detector that leverages this measure as a primary cue for detection in dynamic settings.
blocks.zh: 提出一个视听的深假探测器,利用这一措施作为在动态环境中进行探测的主要提示。

blocks.en: Demonstrate robust performance on dynamic speaking videos and consistent ensemble gains with lip–speech synchronization detectors, indicating complementarity.
blocks.zh: 用唇语同步探测器显示动态语音视频的强效性能和一致的共聚增益,表明互补性.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en:
This section presents our physics-aware deepfake detection framework based on physical alignment between the speaker’s visual distance and speech acoustics.
We first introduce the acoustic principle and distance-related measures used in our method (Sec. 2.1 ).
We then describe how we extract acoustic measures and relative speaker distance, and how we convert them into robust video-level features by distance-wise binning and distributional statistics, e.g ., variance and entropy (Sec. 2.2 ).
Finally, we build a lightweight multi-layer perceptron (MLP) that maps these statistics to a deepfake score (Sec. 2.3 ).
blocks.zh:
本节介绍我们基于演讲者视觉距离和语音声学之间的物理认识深假探测框架。
我们首先介绍我们方法中使用的声学原理和与距离有关的措施(第2.1节)。
然后,我们描述我们如何提取声学计量和相对扬声器距离,以及如何通过远距离的宾带和分布统计,例如差异和 en(第2.2条)。
最后,我们建立了一个轻量级的多层感知器(MLP),将这些统计数据映射到一个深假分(Sec. 2.3.

blocks.en: 2.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 2.1 初步情况

blocks.en: In real-world recordings, a speaker’s distance and speech signals are coupled through acoustic propagation: as distance increases, speech intensity decreases, and vice versa [ 25 , 26 ] . This is known as the inverse-square law. Based on this principle, we use two acoustic measures, signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and clarity at 50 ms ( C 50 C_{50} ), to capture distance-dependent behavior and assess physical consistency between spatial and acoustic signals.
blocks.zh: 在现实世界的录音中,演讲者的距离和语音信号通过声波传播来配合:随着距离的增加,语音强度降低,反之亦然[25,26]. 此名为逆法. 基于这一原则,我们使用信号对噪比(SNR)和50ms(C50 C_{50})的清晰度两个声学度量,来捕捉依赖距离的行为和评估空间信号和声学信号之间的物理一致性.

blocks.en:
In acoustics, the inverse-square law describes the physical relationship between sound intensity and the source-receiver distance [ 23 ] .
Assuming a source radiates power P P uniformly, the acoustic intensity I I at distance d d follows: I = P 4 ​ π ​ d 2 ∝ 1 d 2 . I=\frac{P}{4\pi d^{2}}\propto\frac{1}{d^{2}}. Directly applying the inverse-square law to real-world recordings is often unreliable due to automatic gain control (AGC), device-specific amplification, and recording-level normalization. We therefore employ relative energy measures [ 23 , 27 ] that are robust to these effects.
Specifically, we utilize the Signal-to-Noise Ratio ( SNR ) and Clarity at 50ms ( C 50 {C}_{50} ), which capture ratios of energy rather than absolute magnitudes and thus reflect the inverse-square attenuation of direct sound.
This makes them particularly suitable for in-the-wild videos where calibrated signals or ground-truth acoustic measurements are typically unavailable.
blocks.zh:
在声学中,反方定律描述了声音强度和源接收器距离之间的物理关系[23].
假设源辐射功率PP一致,则距离d d的声学强度I如下: I = P 4 = d 2 = 1 d 2 。 I=\frac{ P}{4\pi} 页面存档备份,存于互联网档案馆 d^{2}}\propto\frac{1}{d^{2}}. 由于自动增益控制(AGC),设备特定放大,以及录制水平的正常化,直接将反方法应用于现实世界的录音往往不可靠. 因此,我们采用相对的能源措施[23、27],这些措施对这些影响是强有力的。
具体地说,我们采用信号对噪比(SNR)和50ms(C 50 {C}_{50})的Clarity,它捕捉能量比而不是绝对的量级,从而反映直接声音的反方衰减。
这使得它们特别适合通常无法校准信号或地面真声测量的无线视频。

blocks.en:
SNR measures the relative energy between the target source signal and environmental noise [ 27 ] .
Let S received S_{\text{received}} denotes the speech signal captured by the microphone and N env N_{\text{env}} denotes environmental noise.
In typical recording conditions, environmental noise varies more slowly than the direct speech component within a short temporal window.
Under this approximation, the variation of SNR is primarily governed by the attenuation of the direct sound with distance.
Thus, when the direct part of speech signal follows the inverse-square law, the SNR of the received signal approximately follows: SNR [dB] ≈ 10 ​ log 10 ⁡ ( 𝔼 ⁡ [ S received 2 ] 𝔼 ⁡ [ N env 2 ] ) ∝ − 20 ​ log 10 ⁡ ( r ) . \text{SNR~[dB]}\approx 10\log_{10}\left(\frac{\mathbb{E}[S_{\text{received}}^{2}]}{\mathbb{E}[N_{\text{env}}^{2}]}\right)\propto-20\log_{10}(r).
blocks.zh:
SNR测量目标源信号与环境噪声之间的相对能量[27].
让S收到SQQText{收到}}表示麦克风捕获的语音信号,Nenv NQQNQText{env}}表示环境噪声.
在典型的录音条件下,环境噪声在短时间窗口内比直接的语音部分更慢.
在这种近似下,SNR的变异主要受直音随距离的减弱所支配.
因此,当语音信号的直接部分遵循反方定律时,接收信号的SNR大致如下: SNR [dB] ≈ 10 log 10 ⁡ (E ⁡ [S 接收 2] E ⁡ [N env 2]). \\ text{SNR~[dB]}大约10\log}左(\frac\mathbb{E}[S_{\text{ received}}}} \ mathbb{E} [N_{\text{env}}^{2}}}\propto-20\log_{10}(r).

blocks.en:
C 50 C_{50} measures speech clarity by computing the decibel ratio between the energy arriving within the first 50ms (direct sound and early reflections) and the energy arriving afterward (late reverberation) in the received signal [ 28 ] . Because the early component is typically dominated by the direct sound, which approximately follows inverse-square attenuation of the source energy ( E source / r 2 E_{\text{source}}/r^{2} ), C 50 C_{50} can be approximated as: C 50 ​ [dB] ≈ 10 ​ log 10 ⁡ ( E source / r 2 E late ) ∝ − 20 ​ log 10 ⁡ ( r ) , C_{50}~\text{[dB]}\approx 10\log_{10}\left(\frac{E_{\text{source}}/r^{2}}{E_{\text{late}}}\right)\propto-20\log_{10}(r), where E late E_{\text{late}} denotes the energy of late reflections.
Although C 50 C_{50} is commonly used in room acoustics, the same intuition extends to outdoor recordings where the signal still contains a direct propagation component [ 28 , 29 ] . Consequently, C 50 C_{50} provides a physically grounded cue for the source–receiver distance.
blocks.zh:
C 50 C_{50}通过计算在前50ms(直接音效和早期反射)内到达的能量和在接收到的信号中到达的能量(迟回反射)之间的分贝比来测量语音清晰度[28]. 由于早期的构件一般以直接音为主,大约与源能量的反平衰减(E ource / r 2 E_{\text{source}}/r^{2}),C 50 C_{50}可以大致为:C 50 [dB] 10 log 10 ⁡ (E ource / r 2 E lated ) ∝ 20 log 10 ⁡ (r),C_{50}~\text{ [dB] 约 10\log_{10}\左 (\frac{E_{\text{source}}/r^{2}}{text{t+lat}}}\right)\propto-20\log_{10}(r),其中E_{\text{late}}表示晚反射能量.
虽然C 50 C_{50}通常用于房间声学, 但同样的直觉延伸到户外录音, 信号仍然包含直接的传播成分 [28, 29]. 因此,C 50 C_{50}为来源 - 接收方距离提供了实际提示。

blocks.en: 2.2 Extracting Distance-dependent Acoustic Features
blocks.zh: 2.2 提取远距离依赖声学特征

blocks.en:
Our framework extracts physically meaningful features by jointly using acoustic propagation and visual distance cues (see Fig. 2 ).
We derive acoustic measures (SNR and C 50 C_{50} ) from speech signals and estimate the relative speaker distance from video frames.
These signals are then aggregated through distance-wise binning and statistical modeling to obtain video-level features.
blocks.zh:
我们的框架通过联合使用声波传播和视觉距离提示(见图2)来提取物理上有意义的特征。
我们从语音信号中得出声学测量(SNR和C 50 C_{50}),并估计视频帧的相对扬声器距离.
这些信号然后通过远程宾加和统计模型进行汇总,以获得视频级功能.

blocks.en:
We extract SNR and C 50 C_{50} from the speech signal.
To compute these, the speech component must be separated from environmental noise.
Thus, we employ SAM Audio [ 14 ] with the text prompt “speech” to isolate the speech signal from the input audio.
Using the separated signals, we compute SNR and C 50 C_{50} over temporal windows of 300 ms, which covers typical syllable durations in speech [ 30 ] while capturing most of reflections associated with room reverberation [ 31 ] .
This design enables stable estimation of the acoustic measures while reducing interference from adjacent utterances.
blocks.zh:
我们从语音信号中提取SNR和C 50 C_{50}
要计算这些,语音部分必须与环境噪声分开.
因此,我们使用SAM Audio [14] ,文本提示“speech”将语音信号与输入音频隔离。
利用分离的信号,我们计算SNR和C 50 C_{50}超过300 ms的时空窗口,它涵盖语音中典型的音节持续时间[30],同时捕捉大多数与房间反射有关的反射[31].
这种设计能够稳定地估计声学措施,同时减少相邻的语音干扰。

blocks.en:
We estimate the relative distance between the speaker and the camera for each frame.
Facial landmarks are detected using RetinaFace [ 13 ] to localize the speaker region.
A dense depth map of the frame is estimated using MiDaS [ 12 ] .
We then obtain speaker distance by averaging the depth values within the detected facial region, and its inverse is used as a proxy for the speaker’s relative distance d s ​ p ​ k d_{spk} .
blocks.zh:
我们估计每个帧的扬声器和相机之间的相对距离.
利用 RetinaFace [13] 检测到面部地标,使扬声区域本地化.
使用MiDAS [12] 估计了框架的密集深度图.
然后我们通过平均检测到的面部区域的深度值来获得扬声器距离,其反面值被用作扬声器相对距离ds p k d_{spk}的代名词。

blocks.en:
We use the speaker distance d s ​ p ​ k d_{spk} to group acoustic measures into distance bins.
Specifically, a distance range within each video is partitioned into the bins, and acoustic measures are averaged within each bin.
This reduces fluctuations in vocal intensity and phonetic content that may violate the constant-power assumption of the physical model, allowing the acoustic measures to follow an attenuation trend: 𝔼 ⁡ [ { SNR , C 50 } ∣ d s ​ p ​ k ] ∝ − 20 ​ log 10 ⁡ ( d s ​ p ​ k ) . \mathbb{E}[\{\mathrm{SNR},{C}_{50}\}\mid d_{spk}]\propto-20\log_{10}(d_{spk}).
blocks.zh:
我们用扬声器的距离 d s p k d_{spk 来将声学测量分解为距离的插件.
具体来说,每个视频内部的距离范围被分割到垃圾箱中,每个垃圾箱内部平均进行声学测量.
这可以减少可能违反物理模型常功假设的声响强度和声调内容的波动,使声调测量能够跟随减弱趋势:E ⁡ [{SNR,C 50} ∣ d s p k] ∝ – 20 log 10 ⁡ (d s p k ). \ mathbb{E} [\{\mathrm{SNR},{C}_{50}\}\mid] (原始内容存档于2019-09-09). d_{spk}.

blocks.en:
Although the expected acoustic measures follow the physical attenuation trend, instantaneous values of SNR and C 50 C_{50} are sensitive to speech variability and environmental noise.
Thus, we characterize the distribution of acoustic measures within each depth bin using variance and entropy, which capture the following relationships.

blocks.en: 2.3 Physics-aware Deepfake Detector
blocks.zh: 2.3 深假探测器

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3 实验

blocks.en:
In this section, we compare our physics-aware detector with state-of-the-art lip-sync-based detectors.
We first evaluate the models on a curated dynamic subset, where physical cues are more informative.
Then, we report ROC–AUC scores of the detectors on full set ( i.e ., both static and dynamic) of in-the-wild benchmarks.
We also present qualitative examples and ablation studies to further analyze the method.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们将我们的物理感知探测器与最先进的唇形合成探测器进行比较.
我们首先对模型进行评估, 在一个精密的动态子集, 在那里,物理提示更加信息化。
然后,我们报告ROC-AUC在全集(即静态和动态)内基准上的探测器分数。
我们还提供了定性实例和消化研究,以进一步分析这种方法。

blocks.en: 3.1 Experiment Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We compare against two state-of-the-art lip-sync-based deepfake detectors, SpeechForensics [ 18 ] and AuViRe [ 19 ] .
Both methods focus on the alignment between lip movements and speech, and adopt AV-HuBERT [ 34 ] as the backbone encoder for audio-visual representation learning.
They have demonstrated strong detection performance on widely used benchmark datasets
that feature relatively static and constrained human speaking settings [ 20 , 21 , 8 , 22 ] ,
often reporting ROC-AUC scores above 0.95.
However, their robustness under unconstrained real-world conditions remains less explored.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了两个最先进的基于唇形合成的深假探测器,SpeechForensics [18] 和 AuVire [19].
这两种方法都注重唇动与语音的对接,采用AV-HuBERT[34]作为视听表现学习的骨干编码器.
它们在广泛使用的基准数据集上表现出强大的探测性能
[20、21、8、22],
经常报告ROC-AUC得分超过0.95.
然而,在不受限制的现实世界条件下,对它们的坚固程度的探讨仍然较少。

blocks.en:
We use Deepfake-Eval-2024 (DF24) [ 24 ] and AuViRe RealWorld (RW) [ 19 ] to evaluate deepfake detection under unconstrained and dynamic conditions.
Both datasets are collected from media platforms and include both static and dynamic videos, although RW is predominantly static. They also span diverse recording environments,
including varying camera motion, environmental noise, and editing artifacts.
To ensure reproducibility, we exclude samples with missing modalities or invalid links.
All models are trained on the DF24 training set (fine-tuning existing detectors [ 18 , 19 ] and training ours from scratch) and evaluated on the DF24 test split (in-domain) and the RW test set (cross-dataset).
In addition, to analyze scenarios where physical cues are most informative, we curate a dynamic subset, DF-Dynamic , by manually selecting videos with noticeable speaker motion from both test sets.
blocks.zh:
我们使用Deepfake-Eval-2024 (DF24)[24]和AuViRe Real World (RW)[19]来评价在不受约束和动态条件下的深假检测.
两个数据集都是从媒体平台收集的,包含静态和动态视频,虽然RW主要是静态的. 它们也跨越不同的录音环境,
包括不同的相机运动,环境噪声,和编辑文物.
为了确保可复制性,我们排除模式缺失或链接无效的样本。
所有型号都接受DF24训练集的培训(精细调整现有探测器[18,19],从零开始训练我们的),并接受DF24试验分裂(域内)和RW试验集(交叉数据集)的评价.
此外,为了分析物理提示信息最丰富的情景,我们通过手动从两个测试集中选择带有显著扬声器运动的视频,来解析一个动态子集DF-Dynamic.

blocks.en: 3.2 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.2 结果和分析

blocks.en:
We first evaluate on the curated dynamic subset, DF-Dynamic , where physical cues are become particularly informative.
Table 1 shows that existing lip-sync-based detectors exhibit limited performance in this setting, while our physics-aware detector achieves a substantially higher ROC-AUC score.
This suggests that when speaker motion and recording conditions vary dynamically, the physical alignment between speaker distance and acoustic behavior provides a more reliable detection signal than lip–speech consistency alone.
blocks.zh:
我们首先评估 被整理的动态子集,DF-Dynamic, 其中物理提示变得特别信息化。
表1显示,现有的以唇合成为主的探测器在这种环境下的性能有限,而我们的物理感知探测器则取得了显著较高的ROC-AUC分数.
这表明当扬声器运动和录音条件动态变化时,扬声器距离和声学行为之间的物理对接提供了比光是唇语一致性更可靠的检测信号.

blocks.en:
We further evaluate our method on full in-the-wild benchmarks [ 24 , 19 ] that include both static and dynamic videos. Table 2 reports (i) in-domain results on the DF24 test set and (ii) cross-dataset results on RW.
On the in-domain DF24 test set, our model achieves a ROC–AUC of 0.7329 0.7329 , outperforming existing detectors, while achieving comparable performance on the RW dataset, which is predominantly static.
Because unconstrained real-world conditions often degrade the mouth region, lip–speech alignment cues become less reliable [ 18 , 19 ] ; in contrast, our physics-aware approach maintains strong performance by leveraging a fundamentally different signal.
Moreover, combining our model with existing detectors via a score-averaging ensemble consistently improves performance across both datasets (Table 2 -(C)). These results indicate that the proposed physical-consistency cue is favorable as a standalone signal, and that it provides complementary information that makes ensembling with lip-sync-based detectors even more effective.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步评估我们的方法,包括静态和动态的视频。 表2报告 (一)DF24测试集的域内结果和 (二)RW的跨数据集结果.
在域内DF24测试集上,我们的模型实现了ROC–AUC的0.73290.7329,优于现有探测器,同时在RW数据集上实现可比较性能,该数据集主要是静态的.
由于不受约束的现实世界条件往往使口腔区域退化,唇语对齐提示变得不那么可靠[18,19];相反,我们的物理意识方法通过利用根本不同的信号保持了强大的性能.
此外,将我们的模型与现有的探测器合并,通过一个计分系统不断提高两个数据集的性能(表2-(C))。 这些结果表明,拟议的物理一致性提示作为一种独立信号是有利的,它提供了补充信息,使得与唇形合成探测器的共鸣更加有效。

blocks.en:
We visualize authentic and deepfake examples to show how acoustic measures vary with
estimated speaker distance (see Fig. 3 ).
In the authentic video, the acoustic measures follow the expected inverse trend: as the speaker moves closer to the camera, both SNR and C 50 C_{50} increase due to stronger speech energy and clearer direct sound.
In contrast, deepfake videos often violate this physical relationship, exhibiting inconsistent distance-acoustic trends.
These examples illustrate that the proposed acoustic features provide physically meaningful signals for distinguishing authentic and deepfake videos.

在真实的视频中,声波测量遵循了预期的反向趋势:随着扬声器靠近镜头,SNR和C 50 C_{50}都因为语音能量更强,直接声音更清晰而增加.
相比之下,深假视频经常违反这种物理关系,表现出不一致的距离声学趋势.
这些例子说明,拟议的声学特征为区分真实和深假视频提供了具有物理意义的信号。

blocks.en: 3.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 3.3 阅读研究

blocks.en:
Table 3 reports the detection performance when subsets of physical features are removed.
Removing the SNR-based statistics ( V ​ a ​ r SNR , H SNR Var_{\textrm{SNR}},\mathrm{H}_{\textrm{SNR}} ) decreases performance on DF24 ( − 0.0262 -0.0262 AUC), while removing the C 50 C_{50} -based statistics ( V ​ a ​ r C 50 , H C 50 Var_{C_{50}},\mathrm{H}_{C_{50}} ) causes the largest degradation, reducing the ROC-AUC on DF24 ( − 0.1169 -0.1169 ) and RW ( − 0.042 -0.042 ).
We further analyze the contribution of the statistical descriptors. Removing variance-related features ( V ​ a ​ r SNR , V ​ a ​ r C 50 Var_{\textrm{SNR}},Var_{C_{50}} ) leads to a noticeable drop, while removing entropy-based features ( H SNR , H C 50 \mathrm{H}_{\textrm{SNR}},\mathrm{H}_{C_{50}} ) also degrades performance across datasets.
Removing the variance ratio feature r v ​ a ​ r r_{var} results in an additional performance decrease ( − 0.0193 -0.0193 AUC on DF24), indicating that the relative variability between acoustic measures provides complementary information.
Overall, best performance is achieved when all physical features are jointly utilized.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduce a physics-aware framework for audio-visual deepfake detection in dynamic speaking videos.
While most existing detectors rely on lip–speech synchronization, which becomes unreliable in dynamic in-the-wild scenarios, we instead leverage a fundamental acoustic constraint linking speaker distance and speech energy.
Our method estimates speaker distance from video and extracts distance-dependent acoustic measures from audio to detect inconsistencies in this relationship. Experiments on curated dynamic subsets show that our approach is particularly effective for dynamic speaking videos.
Moreover, our method complements lip-sync-based detectors through a simple ensemble, consistently improving detection performance across datasets.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们引入了一个物理意识框架,用于在动态说话视频中进行视听深假检测.
虽然大多数现有的探测器都依赖于唇语同步,在动态的万象中,唇语同步变得不可靠,但我们却利用了连接语音距离和语音能量的基本声学制约。
我们的方法估计了与视频的扬声器距离,并从音频中提取了依赖距离的声学测量,以发现这种关系中的不一致之处. 对被整理的动态子集的实验表明,我们的方法对于动态说话视频特别有效.
此外,我们的方法通过简单的综艺节目来补充基于唇形合成的探测器,不断提高各种数据集的探测性能。

blocks.en: Microphones placed close to the speaker can weaken the distance–speech relationship, and rapidly changing background noise can destabilize physics-aware acoustic measurements. Errors in depth and face estimation can degrade final performance. Our framework is speech-agnostic and may extend beyond human speech to general object-level scenarios that follow similar acoustic propagation principles.
blocks.zh: 靠近扬声器的麦克风可以削弱距离 - 语音关系,迅速变化的背景噪声可以破坏物理意识的声学测量. 深度和面部估计的错误可以降低最终性能. 我们的框架是言语不可知的,而且可能超越人类的言语,扩展到遵循类似声学传播原则的一般物体级情景。
